{{Quote|Looks like plans for an Imperial Battle Station!"<br />"Relay it with the next High Security transmissions.|Rebel personnel at AX-235|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>}}
'''AX-235''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] listening post hidden in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] to monitor [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] transmissions detected by some [[communications satellite]]s, stolen from [[Orron III]]. It was the very outpost that intercepted an Imperial transmission with the [[Death Star plans/Legends|schematics]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Due to the importance of what had been discovered, [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] was sent to personally courier the schematics out of AX-235, taking them to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AX-235_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The control room on AX-235.]]
The scenario of [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''X-wing'']] is inconsistent with the canonical history (including the [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] opening crawl), according to which the plans were taken during the [[Battle of Toprawa]]. The plans carried to [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] by Biggs in a later mission of the game are not a result of the battle, but are implied to be the same ones tapped by the outpost.

The image of the outpost's control room is based on [[Ralph McQuarrie]]'s concept art for the [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] control room for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="IonArt">{{Facebook|username=RalphMcQuarrieArt|name=Ralph Mcquarrie Concept Art,Sketches|archivedate=20250407050330}}</ref>
